goal: Rebuild the place booking placement, direct contact actions, Hilat Hanof unit details and mobile topic gallery, then publish only after verification

applicable_lessons.title: Responsive transitions are release-critical state changes
Public mobile screenshots are required release evidence

requirements.statement: Rebuild the place booking placement, direct contact actions, Hilat Hanof unit details and mobile topic gallery, then publish only after verification
requirements.acceptance_check: Public Hilat Hanof desktop and 390px mobile show the date launcher immediately above units, direct phone and WhatsApp, four detailed unit dialogs and per-unit galleries; the mobile gallery provides topic scrolling and full-image viewing without overflow

requirements.statement: Every responsive website must remain correct through mobile-to-desktop and desktop-to-mobile transitions, reloads, orientation changes and browser device-emulation changes, including while overlays and scroll locks are active.
requirements.acceptance_check: A real public route passes fresh desktop, desktop reload, fresh 390-pixel mobile, mobile overlay open followed by desktop resize, desktop reload, breakpoint boundary, orientation change and return to mobile. At every step the page has meaningful visible content, scrollX is zero, document width does not exceed viewport width and desktop has no stale mobile lock, backdrop or expanded state.

requirements.statement: A mobile search product is not visually approved until meaningful content is visible in the viewport and an independent checker inspects both a public-domain screenshot and the live page. DOM presence, text length, build output and overflow measurements alone are insufficient.
requirements.acceptance_check: A public Spa results route with an artificially empty results control must fail with no-visible-results-state or excessive-empty-band, and the report must contain a screenshot path inspected by the independent checker.

requirements.statement: מסלול נייד מלא נבנה ונבדק בפני עצמו, לרבות המסך הראשון, צפיפות, קריאות, גלילה, חלונות, פעולות ומעברי רוחב.
requirements.acceptance_check: שער הראיות נכשל ללא צילום חי של המסך הראשון והמסלול המלא, בדיקת גובה נמוך, מדידת גלישה ומטריצת מעברי רוחב.

requirements.statement: כל כפתור, קישור, לשונית, חץ, תגית, מסנן, תפריט ובקר נראה מבטיח פעולה ולכן חייב להיבדק בכל המצבים החלים עליו וביעד הטבעי של התוצאה.
requirements.acceptance_check: שער הראיות נכשל אם חסר רכיב נראה במלאי, אם התוצאה אינה נצפית ביעד הטבעי, או אם לא נבדקו כל המופעים במשפחה שנכשלה.
